description: Returns only the "since last run" diff for a site: which problems were fixed and which are new in its newest saved run (`aitd run`) compared with the run before it. Compares plan coverage when both runs were checked against a plan, health findings otherwise. Does not browse or use an AI. Use it to answer "what changed on this site?" without re-reading a whole report.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default en.

site.description: The site, e.g. https://www.example.com/. Its saved runs are the ones in the data folder of the computer running this server.

name: what_changed
title: What changed since the last run
